measurement.query_windows: each query x concurrency x manifest repetition; setup/connect reported separately
measurement.goodput: Unchanged successful expected-row observations / query execution span in microseconds; connect and owner convergence excluded from query goodput/latency and archived separately.
measurement.quantiles: nearest-rank over successful observations; failures retained and counted separately
measurement.relative_spread: (maximum - minimum) / median across the three manifest repetitions of each query/concurrency window
measurement.cpu: Sum exact same PID/start-token per-role cumulative CPU over explicit before-connect and after-actual-owner-convergence window boundaries, divided by successful observations. Each window must have exactly two samples per role and the complete unique frozen window set. Continuous monitor is RSS/diagnostic only. Post-window management observation cost is included equally for old/candidate; inter-window idle wait excluded.
measurement.rss: per-role monitor high water; not an attribution charge or transport coefficient
measurement.probe: 64KiB row scratch; wire rows hashed while streamed, metadata separately hashed
measurement.background_load: no concurrent task-owned Cargo, full suite, or benchmark during sampling; inspect external process load and record contamination; do not terminate unrelated work
measurement.on_noise: inconclusive; rerun identical inputs and frozen gates after identifying external load
measurement.owner_barrier: Before and after each query x concurrency x repetition, two consecutive observed zero snapshots separated by at least 100ms; 30s absolute barrier cap, at most 301 snapshots; actual Worker reservation publication required, ordinary/control ingress running/waiting and candidate root_result ingress; exact FE active/governance plus old held/result credits or new four window positions. Missing, duplicate, malformed observations fail, never default zero. Every barrier sample and error archived.

acceptance: NOT_RUN; smoke cannot replace frozen matrix, native tails, transport coefficients or Linux manual gate
refinement: Retain failed v1/v2 results. Observe actual ownership between windows rather than allowing preceding settlement to overlap the next measurement. Explicit CPU boundaries avoid inventing cross-clock alignment. Same old release server, SQL, configuration, repetitions and numeric gates; no admission changes, replay eviction, server restart between windows or threshold relaxation. In-window overload remains failure.
